## Security engineering checks

- [ ] Threat rationale is documented
- [ ] Required telemetry is documented
- [ ] ATT&CK mapping was reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Query was tested against an authorized environment or representative dataset
- [ ] Known false positives / benign causes are documented
- [ ] Investigation or next-step guidance is included
- [ ] No secrets, tenant identifiers or sensitive production data are committed

Describe how the change was validated.
